scope: Read-only source inspection of native(); no solver, no pilot edits.
resolved_initial_findings: Initial version relied only on saved peer audit; current version writes fresh PRE_OPTIMIZE_PEERS immediately before durable latch.
Initial version admitted finite Gurobi +/-1e100 sentinel; current valid test requires math.isfinite(bound) and abs(bound)<GRB.INFINITY.
Initial memory growth narrative asserted an unmeasured factor; current estimate records max(2GiB,4x observed build private growth).
nonblocking_observations: Current result peak_private_commit_bytes is the maximum sampled Private_Commit_bytes; memory() also captures OS Peak_Private_Commit_bytes, which can capture a between-callback spike. Prefer the OS peak when available, or explicitly label the field sampled peak.
Peer loaded-module scan catches a running Gurobi solve. Expanding peer command tokens to the audit helper worker tokens can also reject a new worker in its earlier import/build phase.

The .5-second resource sampling interval is callback-driven; it is not a guarantee of a callback every .5 seconds. A supported Gurobi SoftMemLimit may supplement monitoring, but the checked actual system reserve and growth gates are the admission policy.
conclusion: Critical resource, single-optimize, readback and numerical-bound validity controls PASS by static review of the recorded version. This review is not mathematical certification, a post-build memory observation, or authorization for another Native call.
